title: $11 Billion in Fake Profits. Found at Night. #shorts
description:
In two thousand two, a small team of internal auditors at WorldCom uncovered one of the biggest accounting frauds in history, working in secret, at night.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
$11 BILLION OF FAKE PROFIT
FOUND IN SECRET
first_comment: Would you have blown the whistle on your own bosses, or kept quiet and kept your job? 👇

lines.text: Eleven billion dollars of fake profits, found by auditors working in secret.
How do you hide that much money?
WorldCom was America's second-biggest long-distance phone company.
Its bosses turned everyday costs into investments. Billions of dollars of them.
On paper, profits stayed strong. In reality, they were losses.
Then an auditor found entries nobody could explain.
Her team checked the books at night, in secret.
In twenty oh two, WorldCom went bankrupt, the biggest in American history.
Its CEO got twenty-five years. All because a few auditors stayed late.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
